2014_spells.leomund-s-tiny-hut.effectSum: Move a creature or object a short distance
2014_spells.leomund-s-tiny-hut.fullDescr: Using 1 minute, the spell fails if a creature larger than the space inside the dome is in the area when you cast the spell. A 10-foot-radius immobile dome of force springs into existence around and above you and remains stationary for the duration; Nine creatures of Medium size or smaller can fit inside the dome. Until the spell ends, you can command the interior to become dimly lit or dark; you can cast it as a ritual.
